mapping.how: each unpaired UTF-16 surrogate of the string, or the object key, at a listed JSON pointer becomes U+FFFD (String.prototype.toWellFormed); nothing else changes

refusedByRule.check: the client failure detail equals coreMustAnswer whole; the local server got no request (nor the language server, which reports each request it receives there); for an MCP server, mcp/mcpStatus and mcp/getMcpServerConfig of its name answer after the call what they answered before it
refusedByRule.decision: decisions.md "Lone UTF-16 surrogates in client strings": a field whose value becomes a header, a URL, a path, a command or an identifier refuses the call naming the field, before anything is stored or sent; Node may store or forward it, and the refusal without side effect is the accepted difference
